'''Admiral_Sjet Fully Armed and Operational Battlestation''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Admiral_Sjet]]
* '''Published:''' 11 June 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif|label=Endor Operations}}
* '''Strategy:''' Endor Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 EOps Admiral_Sjet DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Death Star II is Perhaps the most deadly card ot out yet....

The published list has 66 cards.

== Strategy ==

The Strategy is to get the Death Star II Operation Within the first two turns. Take the Flagship Executor Out From the Reserve Deck, since its not a guarantee that a starship will be in your hand. The Main Point of the Deck is to hold the system the Death Star II is at (Thrawn + Chimaera, Guri + Stinger, Imperial Command + Death Star II: Capacitors, Xizor + Virago = extra battledestinies at places), while destroying your opponent on the ground. Normal Force Activiation in one turn ususally exceeds 10, so the high deploy characters in this deck are easy to get out. Its basically a Big Bruiser deck. Either Battle or Force Drain.
